title: Host Accounts Standing Thresholds: Cancellation Rate and Policy Strikes
content:
# Host Accounts — Standing Thresholds

Trust and safety and host support apply the following thresholds to the standing of every Host Accounts holder. Only the cancellation-rate threshold differs between host tiers.

## Cancellation rate

| Host tier | Cancellation rate at or above which the account is restricted |
|---|---|
| Starter Host | 5.00% |
| Standard Host | 3.00% |
| Superhost | 3.00% |
| Professional Host | 2.00% |
| Professional Host Plus | 2.00% |
| Enterprise Partner | 1.50% |

| Item (all six tiers) | Threshold |
|---|---|
| History over which the cancellation rate is measured | 365 calendar days |
| Fewest stays in that history before the rate is applied | 10 stays |
| Length of a cancellation-rate or strike restriction | 30 calendar days |
| New bookings while restricted | None accepted on the account's listings |

## Policy strikes

| Item (all six tiers) | Threshold |
|---|---|
| Period over which strikes are counted | 365 calendar days |
| Strikes at which the account is restricted | 2 |
| Strikes at which the account is suspended | 3 |
| Strike types that suspend on the first occurrence | Discrimination; safety violation |
| Payouts during a suspension | Every payout of the account is held |

## Points of reading

- **Is the rate threshold "at or above" or "above"?** At or above. A Standard Host at exactly 3.00% has reached the threshold; at 2.99% it has not.
- **Does a lower threshold mean a stricter tier?** Yes, in the sense that a smaller share of cancellations reaches it: an Enterprise Partner reaches its threshold at 1.50%, a Starter Host only at 5.00%.
- **Hypothetical comparison:** an account whose measured rate is 2.50% has reached the threshold of a Professional Host (2.00%) but not that of a Standard Host (3.00%).
